verses.text: Look, the Lord GOD of Armies is about to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything they depend on: all their food and all their water;
the strong man and the soldier, the judge and the prophet, the fortune teller and the elder,
the captain of fifty and the respected man, the adviser, the skilled craftsman, and the clever magician.
I will make boys their leaders, and children will rule over them.
The people will treat each other cruelly, each person against another, neighbor against neighbor. The young will be rude to the old, and worthless people will insult the respected.
A man will grab his brother in his father's house and say, "You have a coat, so you be our leader. Take charge of this pile of ruins!"
But on that day he will shout, "I cannot fix this! There is no food or clothing in my house. Do not make me leader of the people."
For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because what they say and what they do is against the LORD. They insult his glorious presence.
The look on their faces gives them away. They show off their sin like Sodom. They do not even hide it. How terrible for them! They have brought disaster on themselves.
Tell the righteous that it will go well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of what they have done.
How terrible for the wicked! Disaster is coming on them, for they will be paid back for what their hands have done.
As for my people, children treat them cruelly, and women rule over them. My people, your leaders mislead you and confuse the path you should take.
The LORD stands up to argue his case. He stands to judge the peoples.
The LORD brings his charge against the elders and leaders of his people: "You are the ones who have ruined my vineyard. What you stole from the poor is in your houses.
How dare you crush my people and grind the faces of the poor into the dust?" says the Lord GOD of Armies.
The LORD also says, "The women of Zion are proud. They walk with their heads held high and flirting eyes. They take dainty little steps with jingling ornaments on their ankles.
So the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their heads bald."
On that day the Lord will take away all their finery: their ankle bracelets, headbands, and moon shaped necklaces,
their earrings, bracelets, and veils,
their headdresses, ankle chains, sashes, perfume bottles, and charms,
their signet rings and nose rings,
their fine robes, capes, cloaks, and purses,
their mirrors, fine linen clothes, crowns, and shawls.
Instead of sweet perfume, there will be a bad smell. Instead of a belt, a rope. Instead of nicely styled hair, baldness. Instead of a fine robe, rough sackcloth. Instead of beauty, burn marks.
Your men will fall by the sword, and your warriors in battle.
The gates of Zion will weep and mourn. She will be empty and will sit on the ground.
